novel_features.name: Monitor run to completion
novel_features.description: Watch a dbt Cloud run until it finishes, with live status and an exit code that reflects success or failure.
novel_features.rationale: No single API call blocks until a run completes; this polls and surfaces failed-step logs so CI and scripts can gate on the result.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to block a script or CI step on a dbt run and get a real exit code plus failure context.

novel_features.name: Trigger and wait
novel_features.description: Trigger a job and watch the resulting run to completion in one command, returning the run's exit status.
novel_features.rationale: Combines trigger plus monitor plus failure surfacing into one compound workflow the API exposes only as separate calls.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this as the CI-grade run-a-job-and-fail-on-error loop.

novel_features.name: Run-history stats
novel_features.description: Success rate, average and p95 duration, and failure counts per job over a time window from the local run mirror.
novel_features.rationale: Requires aggregating run history that lives only as paginated API responses; computed locally after sync.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this for reliability and velocity review across many runs, not a single run.

novel_features.name: Recent failures
novel_features.description: Recently failed runs in a time window, grouped by job, with each run's failed-step names.
novel_features.rationale: Time-windowed cross-job failure clustering that no single endpoint returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to triage what broke recently across all jobs.

novel_features.name: Artifact diff
novel_features.description: Diff run_results.json between two runs to show which models newly failed or changed timing.
novel_features.rationale: Correlates artifacts from two runs locally; the API only serves one artifact per call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to hunt regressions between two runs.

narrative.headline: Operate dbt Cloud jobs and runs from one static Go binary — trigger, watch to completion with honest exit codes, and query run history offline.
narrative.value_prop: Covers the dbt Cloud Administrative API v2 jobs, runs, and artifacts surface, then adds the operate-and-watch loop (monitor, trigger --wait) and local run-history analytics (runs stats, failures, artifacts diff) that thin API wrappers don't. Agent-native --json output throughout.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set DBT_CLOUD_TOKEN (a Personal Access Token or service token) and DBT_CLOUD_ACCOUNT_ID. For regional dbt Cloud, set DBT_CLOUD_HOST (default https://cloud.getdbt.com). Tokens are sent as Authorization: Bearer.

quickstart.comment: verify config and reachability before anything else
see recent runs (replace 123456789 with your account_id or set DBT_CLOUD_ACCOUNT_ID)

troubleshoots.fix: Check DBT_CLOUD_TOKEN is a valid PAT or service token with API access.
Set DBT_CLOUD_ACCOUNT_ID; confirm DBT_CLOUD_HOST matches your dbt Cloud region.

narrative.when_to_use: Use when operating dbt Cloud jobs from a terminal, CI, or an agent: triggering jobs and blocking on the result, inspecting run history, or fetching artifacts. Strongest where you need a real exit code on run success/failure.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to run dbt models locally (that is the open-source dbt CLI).
Do not use it for dbt Cloud account/user/project administration (out of scope; that is API v3).
